label: fix 1: shell-me
result:
I rewrote `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/shell-me.md` so that all 20 skeptic failures are fixed, and updated the scorecard to match. I checked the table formatting; I did not commit, and I edited no other file.

1. **Sidebar height** (U26, overrides 6–8): the nav items never scroll. Everything else shrinks in three height tiers (≥ 1100, 760–1099, 580–759px), and each tier's worst-case total is worked out. The Today card drops its questions bar, and Plan's meta drops "28 q". The rail gets its own budget. Acceptance checks at 1366×657, 1440×790 and 1280×900.
2. **Report check** (U3): `broken` is tried first and `explained` last. `explained` now needs a second signal: how students who are Strong in the skill answer that question type (at least 20 answers, picking the reported option no more than twice the base rate). The wording says what was checked ("The numbers check out…"). Stem, figure and option categories always go to a person. New acceptance: a stem that contradicts its params returns `unsure`.
3. **Unknown College Board ID** (U2): returns `via:'none'` with a paste-or-pick-skill fallback, never an empty result. Unknown IDs are logged in `cb_unknown`. Helper text states real coverage (1,039 of 1,921). A T-bank `cb-ingest` task uses the existing `tools/extract_material.py` to close the gap. The bulk importer handles unmatched rows.
4. **Sign-in merge** (U19, U20): the student chooses "Add these 24 answers" or "Don't add them". Add is never the default on a shared computer or for answers over 24 h old, and the server defaults to `carry:false`. `/signin/` opens on the method this device used last.
5. **Devices and sign out** (U21): saving gives the saving browser its own `d:` token, and the `a:` code stops working as a credential. A one-time 10-minute transfer code replaces Show / Copy, and the rotate call is removed. Sign out removes that student from `satf.profiles` and sends the revoke on toast close or `pagehide`. A shared-computer sign out is immediate. "Students on this device" is off until "This is a family device" is turned on.
6. **Prerender** (U23): a new `UI.whenVisible` wraps every "seen / shown" write, sheet, hint, toast and `/seen` call. Acceptance on `satf.seen.report`.
7. **Interruptions** (U25, U14): at most one sheet opens by itself per day. Welcome-back merges into the week sheet and counts only study days. Nothing auto-opens on `?next=1`, notifications or any deep link. Toasts queue while a sheet is open. Mon–Fri acceptance added.
8. **Phone sheet** (U26, override 9): Review, Words, Compete, Class and Quick sit in a footer that is always visible. The inbox shows 3 rows. Swipe-up is dropped for a grip button. The top bar fits 360px with a 3-digit count. Acceptance at 390×844 and 360×740 with a count of 114.
9. **Nav and sections**: a real Profile item (`G U`) that Me, Settings and Sign in map to. One sticky section bar built from `UI.shell({sections})` lists all 16 Me cards at every width, replacing the in-nav sub-links.
10. **Projection** (U9): needs 3 sittings over at least 21 days. The slope is shrunk by n/(n+3), gains taper to at most 20 a week after week 4, and the cone comes from the fit's residuals plus the band. Labelled "If this pace held". The date chips show it only when it is within ±80. The acceptance example now projects about 683, under 700.
11. **Avatar** (U22): all glyphs are free from day one, and reaching Strong adds a ring. The living mark shows only to the student, their classes and their progress links. Boards never carry mastery, with an acceptance check on board payloads.
12. **Classes** (U27, R4): creating a class needs a verified email (a passkey alone gets 403 `{need:'email'}`). Joining students see the teacher's verified domain. Free-mail classes are capped at 40, and every class page has "Report this class".
13. **Snapshot** (U11): the Climb window widens (±40, ±80, ±160, everyone) and is stated. A Country line is added. "You, N days ago" shows from day 8.
14. **Up next points** (U1): a formula per kind (skill, redo share, habit sum). Every other kind shows no points. Plan check-ins are de-duplicated by pool.
15. **Preferences** (U15, override 22): rows added for Words a day, New words from (SAT words and transitions only) and Test timing. The mode governs only built sets, Up next's skill and probe rows, and the time box. Fixing drills always show the key after each answer.
16. **Saved** (override 30): "Saved words" and "Marked for review" rows added.
17. **Skills** (U4, U5): one evidence ladder (0 / 1–4 / 5–9 / 10 or more), and U5's acceptance now uses 6 answers.
18. **Reminders** (U18): push moves into the core build and generates its own keys when none are set. Feed titles are generic. Added step-by-step alert setup for Google and Apple, an Add to Google Calendar recurring event, and a recurring `.ics` download.
19. **Account menu** (U26, override 10): Dark theme and Large text are proper menu checkbox rows in the keyboard order. The inbox is capped at 3 plus "See all". Keyboard shortcuts becomes plain text. Sign out is reachable in at most 12 ArrowDown presses.
20. **Also**: the §3 overrides (§1, §2.2–§2.14, §3–§10, server, acceptance, open questions) and the §3.2 outside-section rows (R1, R4, R9, R11, R12, R13, R16, R17, R18b, §2.5, §2.9) now match all of the above. The measured-facts list notes the 54% College Board coverage. Three items are added to Rejected: swipe-up, sub-links in the sidebar, and locked glyphs.
